description: This file defines functions to interact with a backend API for event management and weather data retrieval. It includes fetch calls for getting events, creating events, and fetching current weather and forecast data, and also exports these functions for use in other parts of the frontend application.
external_files: node_modules fetch polyfill (if used in environment)

methods.name: http(path, options = {})
methods.description: Internal helper function to perform HTTP requests with proper error handling and content-type processing.

methods.name: getEvents({ page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of events from the backend API.

methods.name: createEvent(payload)
methods.description: Creates a new event by sending a POST request with payload.

methods.name: getCurrentWeather({ q, lat, lon, units = 'metric', lang } = {})
methods.description: Fetches current weather data from backend proxy, with optional query parameters.

methods.name: getForecast({ q, lat, lon, units = 'metric', lang } = {})
methods.description: Fetches weather forecast data from backend proxy, with optional query parameters.

ctags.name: getCurrentWeather
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getCurrentWeather({ q, lat, lon, units = 'metric', lang } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: getForecast
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getForecast({ q, lat, lon, units = 'metric', lang } = {}) {$/
